mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PAID', 'FINISHED') AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at >= #{startTime} AND paid_at <= #{endTime} THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayRevenue, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PAID', 'FINISHED') AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at >= #{startTime} AND paid_at <= #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayOrderCount FROM order_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( (paid_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at >= #{startTime} AND paid_at <= #{endTime}) OR (created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}) )

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM order_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at >= #{startTime} AND paid_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%m-%d')

SELECT payment_method AS paymentMethod, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM order_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_method
